items.title: Earnings Beat Tests The Case For KLA Stock
items.summary: KLA Corporation reported fiscal first quarter 2027 revenue of US$4.14b and net income of US$1.55b, with GAAP diluted EPS of US$1.18 from continuing operations. Management paired this strong print and guidance with commentary that higher memory costs and export related pressures are still squeezing gross margins and shaping the pace of any recovery.
